constraint_hints: Prefer extracting small private helpers instead of rewriting the whole method in one patch.
Keep each helper focused on one branch/phase so follow-up edits can land incrementally.
New helpers should default to private methods unless the contract explicitly requires broader visibility.
Any touched async method must use an Async suffix and a Task/Task<T> return type.
Do not keep async on helpers or methods that no longer contain a real await.
Avoid introducing new public or protected surface area unless the contract explicitly requires it.
